title: Prepaid low-balance & top-up journey (India)
assumptions: Vocabularies, pack prices and rates are ILLUSTRATIVE defaults chosen from public knowledge of Indian prepaid behaviour; calibrate them with your operator's aggregates (they are plain data in this pack).
Each row is one low-balance episode that ended in a top-up request; history is the subscriber's most recent N episodes, newest last generated backwards from the reference time.
Top-up amount is always money (INR); bucket remaining is in the bucket's own unit (INR for monetary, MB for data).
Auto-recharge users are limited to 7/14/28-day packs because TMF recurringPeriod only has weekly/fortnightly/monthly.
customer_valid_to is the date the subscriber relationship lapses unless another recharge happens: latest top-up validity end (or request time) plus a 90-day lapse period (reference.lapse_days).

account_id.description: Prepaid account of the subscriber (one per customer).

state.description: Indian state / union territory of the subscriber.

customer_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the customer relationship.

customer_status_reason.description: Why the customer is not active (empty while active).

topup_channel.description: Channel through which the top-up was requested (readable code).

topup_payment_method.description: Instrument used to pay for the top-up.

topup_requestor_role.description: Who requested the top-up: the subscriber, a retailer or the system (auto-recharge).

topup_requestor_id.description: Identifier of the requestor (subscriber id, retailer id or SYSTEM).

usage_type.description: Type of balance credited by the top-up and held by the bucket (monetary | data). One fact: a top-up funds the bucket that triggered it.

bucket_remaining.description: Balance left in the bucket when the low-balance trigger fired.

offer_channel.description: Channel of the proactive intervention; null when none was sent.

trigger_at.description: Moment the balance crossed the low-balance threshold (RFC-3339).

trigger_threshold.description: Low-balance threshold in the bucket's own unit (INR for monetary, MB for data).

customer_valid_to.description: Date until which the subscriber relationship stays valid without another recharge: the end of the latest top-up validity (or the request when it grants none) plus the operator's lapse period.

exclusions.name: ^(accumulated_balance|adjust_balance|balance_action_history|reserve_balance|transfer_balance)_
exclusions.reason: Other TMF654 balance operations. They repeat the same facets as TopupBalance and are not part of a low-balance top-up journey.

exclusions.name: ^customer_credit_profile_
exclusions.reason: Credit scoring is a postpaid concept; prepaid subscribers have no credit profile.

exclusions.name: party_account_status$
exclusions.reason: Due/paid/in-arrears is a postpaid billing state; a prepaid account is funded in advance.

exclusions.name: social_network_id$
exclusions.reason: Social-network identifiers are PII-like and excluded by the scenario (no sensitive PII).

exclusions.name: ^customer_(agreement|related_party|payment_method)_id$
exclusions.reason: Opaque reference id with no analytical signal for this scenario.

exclusions.name: ^topup_?balance_(logical_resource|payment_method|related_party|requestor|balance_topup|party_account)_id$
exclusions.reason: Opaque cross-reference id (duplicates an entity key or carries no signal).

title: Low balance - communication suppression (prepaid, India)
assumptions: Vocabularies, probabilities and windows in this pack are ILLUSTRATIVE defaults chosen from public knowledge of Indian prepaid operations; calibrate them with the operator's aggregates (they are plain data in this pack).
A row is one low-balance communication decision. It is suppressed when the customer recharged within the cooldown window or already received `frequency_cap` low-balance messages in the last 24 hours.
cooldown_duration is in hours (the variable definition carries no unit).

Related source-document variables (customer, last completed top-up) are generated consistently with the journey: the top-up is the customer's most recent completed one before the event, and the customer relationship starts before it.

account_id.description: Subscriber account identifier (one account per subscriber).

suppression_flag.description: Derived flag: the low-balance communication was suppressed for this trigger.

cooldown_duration.description: Suppression window after a successful recharge, in hours.

low_balance_message_count_24h.description: Low-balance messages the customer already received in the last 24 hours.

communication_attempt_timestamp.description: When the low-balance communication was attempted (or would have been).

last_successful_recharge_timestamp.description: Last successful recharge; it starts the suppression window.

communication_allowed.description: Derived flag: the communication may be sent (the opposite of suppression_flag).

suppress_intent.description: Whether this row is drawn as a suppression case (latent).

message_count_draw.description: Drawn 24h message count before history is applied (latent).

recharge_candidate.description: Drawn recharge time before history is applied (latent).

state.description: Indian state / union territory of the subscriber.

customer_status.description: Lifecycle status of the customer relationship.

topup_status.description: State of the top-up (the latest completed top-up).

invariants.expr: msisdn is None or matches('[+]91[0-9]{10}', msisdn)
invariants.message: MSISDN is E.164 with the +91 country code.

invariants.expr: (not suppression_flag) or (secs(communication_attempt_timestamp, last_successful_recharge_timestamp) < cooldown_duration * 3600 or low_balance_message_count_24h >= REF['frequency_cap'])
invariants.message: A suppressed communication falls inside the cooldown after a recharge, or the 24h frequency cap was reached.

invariants.expr: suppression_flag or (secs(communication_attempt_timestamp, last_successful_recharge_timestamp) >= cooldown_duration * 3600 and low_balance_message_count_24h < REF['frequency_cap'])
invariants.message: A communication that is allowed is outside the cooldown and under the frequency cap.
The recharge that starts the cooldown precedes the attempt.
A customer's last successful recharge never moves back in time.
communication_allowed is the opposite of suppression_flag.
A message count cannot be negative.
State must be an Indian state / UT.
state must not change within a subscriber's history.
Customer status comes from the status vocabulary.
customer_status is a property of the subscriber.
customer_valid_from is a property of the subscriber.
The customer relationship starts before the event.
The customer relationship starts before any top-up it made.
A top-up is credited after it was requested.
The last top-up precedes the event.
The context top-up is a completed one.
A top-up amount is positive.
A customer's last top-up never moves back in time.

emit.expr: max(message_count_draw, 1 if (prev is not None and prev['communication_allowed'] and secs(event_at, prev['communication_attempt_timestamp']) < 86400) else 0)
recharge_candidate if prev is None else max(recharge_candidate, prev['last_successful_recharge_timestamp'])

'cooldown_active' if secs(communication_attempt_timestamp, last_successful_recharge_timestamp) < cooldown_duration * 3600 else ('frequency_cap' if low_balance_message_count_24h >= REF['frequency_cap'] else None)
